info.title: skillforge
info.description: Local, open source CLI for AI agent skills: validate, inspect, diff, eval and package SKILL.md skills, with console, JSON or SARIF output. Nothing is sent to any service.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SkillForge — create, validate, inspect and package AI agent skills.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only errors and the final verdict. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the suggestion attached to each finding. [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable coloured output, for logs and pipes. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a new skill from a template.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Where to create the skill. Defaults to a directory named after the skill.

options.name: --description
options.description: Description for the frontmatter.

options.name: --author
options.description: Author recorded in metadata.

options.name: --license
options.description: SPDX licence identifier. [default: MIT]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing skill in the target directory. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Skill name: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a skill against the SkillForge rules.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as failures. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json, sarif. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write machine-readable output to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --suppress
options.description: Diagnostic codes not to report, comma-separated or repeated (e.g. SF1009,SF1010). Suppressed findings are counted and the count is always shown.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Also check the skill against these agent providers, comma-separated or repeated (e.g. claude-code,codex), even when it does not declare them.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Skill directory, or the path of a SKILL.md file. [default: .]

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Summarise a skill's contents and behaviour surface.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write machine-readable output to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --show-files
options.description: List every file in the skill. [default: False]

options.name: --show-links
options.description: List external URLs. [default: False]

options.name: --show-permissions
options.description: List the capabilities the skill's contents imply. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Skill directory, or the path of a SKILL.md file. [default: .]

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Check a skill against the expectations declared under evals/.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write machine-readable output to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model to ask for model_activation cases, e.g. qwen3:8b or gpt-5. Requires --model-endpoint.

options.name: --model-endpoint
options.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

options.name: --model-api-key-env
options.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key itself is never read from an argument, so it cannot end up in a shell history or a CI log.

options.name: --max-model-requests
options.description: Refuse to make more than this many model requests in one run. [default: 100]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Skill directory, or the path of a SKILL.md file. [default: .]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two versions of a skill by what they can do, not by which bytes changed.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write machine-readable output to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --fail-on-change
options.description: Fail on any surface change, not only on a new error. [default: False]

arguments.name: BEFORE
arguments.description: The earlier version: a skill directory, or the path of a SKILL.md file.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Package a skill into a deterministic archive.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the package to. [default: artifacts]

options.name: --version-override
options.description: Version to package as, overriding the skill's own metadata.

options.name: --skip-validation
options.description: Package even if validation finds errors. Use deliberately. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Skill directory, or the path of a SKILL.md file. [default: .]

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Inspect agent tooling across providers, ahead of moving between them.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Report the installed agent tooling: skills, MCP servers and instruction files, per provider.

options.name: --user-directory
options.description: Read this directory instead of the current user's home directory.

options.name: --probe-mcp
options.description: Ask each HTTP MCP server about itself with one server/discover request. Local stdio servers are never launched. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write machine-readable output to this file instead of stdout.

arguments.name: PROJECT
arguments.description: Project directory to include project-scoped configuration from. Optional; without it only user-scoped configuration is read.
